description: One attachment from a message in the signed-in person's firm mailbox, by message_id and part_id, as base64 (5 MB max). PDF and images unless allow_any_type. Read-only. Sign-in required.

allow_any_type.description: Fetch types other than PDF and images (docx, xlsx...). Defaults to false.

message_id.description: Gmail message id from search_my_email or get_email_thread.

part_id.description: part_id from that message's attachments in get_email_thread.

name: get_gmail_attachment
title: Get email attachment
